scope: Variable-rate physical iPhone screen recording. Compare horizontal text and cell-edge gradients over the overlapping event area in adjacent recorded images no more than 110 ms apart. The maximum search distance is 60 percent of the cropped width. Confident registration requires normalized correlation at least 0.62 and a margin of 0.08 over shifts more than three encoded pixels away. Weak matches can include large changes or ambiguous repeated cells. These sparse recordings cannot exclude a missed frame or prove 120 Hz.
